threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You look bewildered at the bus stop, waiting for the 149 like it’s a magic carpet, not realising it'll be late – just like everything else in Dalston.
Heard a guy on the 77 last night arguing with the bus driver about the correct way to pronounce 'Brixton'. You'd think we had bigger issues!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I spotted a guy in flip-flops chatting up a pigeon outside the Späti at 3 AM, I realized Neukölln had officially claimed me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find spontaneous raves in abandoned buildings, complete with DJs spinning till sunrise. It's like a secret club that finds you.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they navigate the BART delays—utter annoyance but no surprise, like it's part of the daily commute script.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw three folks in tuxedos on the 21 bus yesterday, clearly late for a wedding. Gotta love San Francisco's commitment to looking good, even in transit.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's charm is all about the squares and bars, but it's the whispered secrets in the narrow streets that really make it alive.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their struggle with the metro ticket machines—cluelessly pressing buttons, then looking around for help as locals breeze past.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the Overground is a novelty rather than a way to avoid the Tube strikes. Local wise, you’re still learning the bus routes.
Sat at the back of the 133 last night, overheard a couple arguing about a missing chicken tikka wrap. London at 2 AM is just surreal sometimes.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the local kebab shop started offering vegan döner and the owner knows your order by heart. That's when I felt at home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find a spontaneous techno party under a bridge on a Tuesday night, complete with a buffet of homemade cake.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to pack a snack for the BART delays—food trucks don't wait for equipment failures, and that taco craving won't just disappear.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 19 on Powell, and the driver suddenly stopped for a pigeon just strutting across the tracks—only in SF do we halt for feathered friends.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every bar serves ‘tapas’ when most locals just order ‘cerveses’ and snacks, and that's it. No fancy menus needed.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still call it 'Las Ramblas' with the definite article; true locals just say 'Rambles' like it’s part of the air we breathe.
